plan: Goal: Match composer queued-message editing and Up/Down history behavior
Required: Move the cursor within the input text.
Required: At the upper boundary, retrieve editable queued messages if any exist.
Required: Otherwise browse submitted prompt history.
Required: Navigate back to the live draft.
Required: At the lower boundary of the live draft, enter footer navigation.
Required: Boundary Up retrieves **all editable queued messages**, not just one.
Required: Remove retrieved messages from the live execution queue immediately; they must not execute while being edited.
Required: Preserve queue order, prepend their text to the existing draft, and join nonempty segments with newlines.
Change the behavior where it lives, most likely in `crates/coder-new/src/prompt_queue.rs`, `crates/coder-new/src/ui.rs`.
Add or update a test that pins the new behavior, next to the existing ones in `crates/coder-new/tests/live.rs`.
Run `check:coder-new`, then `test:coder-new`, then `fmt`; stop when they pass.

I didn't need to change any product code: the composer behavior in #11121 was already built in `composer_history.rs`, `prompt_queue.rs` and `lib.rs`. I checked it against the spec and added one end-to-end test, `boundary_up_moves_every_queued_message_into_the_draft`, in `crates/coder-new/tests/live.rs`.

The test runs the issue's example through real key presses. It checks that the "Press up to edit queued messages" hint shows, and that Up brings back both queued messages in order above the draft, keeping the cursor in the same place in the draft text. It also checks that pressing Down doesn't put them back in the queue, nothing runs when the turn finishes, and the hint goes away afterwards.

- **Passed:** the compile check, the new test, a spot-check of one existing history unit test, and `fmt`.
- **Not confirmed:** I couldn't confirm the other existing history and queue unit tests in this session. My filters `composer_history` and `prompt_queue` matched no tests, and two retries with a broader filter didn't compile. Another build was changing the shared build folder (`openagents-target-integrate`) at the same time, and that was also behind a doctest failure (missing crates `coder` and `coder_cloud`). None of these errors point at the new test. Running `cargo test -p coder-new` once the shared build folder is quiet would close this gap.
